en:
Skövde Municipality base map available as OGC WMS 1.3.0 (Web Map Service).
The service provides standard layers such as addresses, buildings, cadastral parcels, street names, road lines, surface details, business plots, detailed development plan areas, parks and municipally owned land. Includes 2019 orthophoto for Stöpen, Skövde and Skultorp.
Intended for use in GIS and map clients.
sv:
Skövde kommuns baskarta tillgänglig som OGC WMS 1.3.0 (Web Map Service).

Avsedd för användning i GIS‑ och kartklienter.
